SELECT rc.loan_id, rc.as_of_date
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
ORDER BY rc.loan_id;

SELECT payment_id, business_date, amount
FROM payment_event
JOIN payment_type_catalog ON payment_event.payment_type = payment_type_catalog.payment_type
WHERE payment_type_catalog.name_zh = '现金支取'
  AND amount > 5000000
ORDER BY amount DESC, payment_id;

SELECT p.party_id, pp.annual_income
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY pp.annual_income DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT card_id, issued_on, expires_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'CREDIT'
ORDER BY issued_on, card_id;

SELECT op.party_id, p.display_name, op.operating_status
FROM organization_profile op
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = (
    SELECT ou_inner.home_org_unit_id
    FROM party p_inner
    JOIN organization_unit ou_inner ON ou_inner.org_unit_id = p_inner.home_org_unit_id
    WHERE ou_inner.unit_name = '上海分行'
    LIMIT 1
)
WHERE op.registered_region = ou.region_code
ORDER BY op.party_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id, 
    ou.unit_name, 
    COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY account_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT i.sector_name_zh, ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
WHERE ca.product_family != 'RETAIL'
GROUP BY i.sector_code, i.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, i.sector_name_zh;

SELECT wp.product_name, ROUND(SUM(phs.fair_value), 2) AS total_market_value
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC, wp.product_name
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id, 
    ou.unit_name, 
    COUNT(*) AS relation_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = p.home_org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY relation_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, 
       ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital, 
       ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS risk_weighted_assets
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY net_capital DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name, ROUND(SUM(abs.ledger_balance), 2) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM account_balance_snapshot abs
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND abs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM account_balance_snapshot)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_deposit_balance DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name, 
       ROUND(AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days), 2) AS avg_overdue_days
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY avg_overdue_days DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT eg.exposure_group_id,
       eg.group_name,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS exposure_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30' AND cs.currency_code = 'CNY'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id, cs.net_capital
ORDER BY exposure_ratio DESC, eg.exposure_group_id;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS total_loan_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS npl_count,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD!DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(ld.loan_id),
        6
    ) AS npl_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN industry_sector i ON i.sector_code = op.industry_code
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE rc.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
    FROM risk_classification rc2 
    WHERE rc2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
)
GROUP BY i.sector_code, i.sector_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY npl_ratio DESC, i.sector_name_zh;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT risk_level, COUNT(*) AS product_count,
       ROUND(AVG(management_fee_rate), 4) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM wealth_product
GROUP BY risk_level
ORDER BY risk_level;

SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_balance
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_balance DESC, guarantor_id;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, 
       COUNT(*) AS record_count, 
       ROUND(SUM(dse.observed_value), 2) AS total_observed_value
FROM data_security_event_v3 dse
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = dse.institution_id
WHERE dse.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_observed_value DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS overdue_records
FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
WHERE (r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
  AND r.deadline_date < '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY overdue_records DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name, ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY capital_adequacy_ratio ASC, i.institution_name;

SELECT ds.loan_id, ds.principal_overdue_days, cg.grade_name_zh, rc.as_of_date
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND rc.grade_code IN ('NORMAL', 'SPECIAL_MENTION')
  AND ds.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(ds2.as_of_date)
      FROM delinquency_snapshot ds2
      WHERE ds2.loan_id = ds.loan_id
  )
  AND rc.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(rc2.as_of_date)
      FROM risk_classification rc2
      WHERE rc2.loan_id = rc.loan_id
  )
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS insufficient_provision_balance
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > 100000000
ORDER BY insufficient_provision_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS payee_name,
    s.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
JOIN industry_sector s ON s.sector_code = op.industry_code
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
WHERE s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
  AND pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id;

WITH instruction_industry AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        pi.instruction_amount,
        s.risk_category
    FROM payment_instruction pi
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = (
        SELECT borrower_party_id FROM credit_agreement WHERE agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    )
    JOIN industry_sector s ON s.sector_code = op.industry_code
    WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
),
institution_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) AS违规_amount,
        SUM(instruction_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM instruction_industry
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(it.违规_amount, 2) AS违规_amount,
    ROUND(it.total_amount, 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(it.违规_amount * 1.0 / NULLIF(it.total_amount, 0), 6) AS ratio
FROM institution_totals it
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = it.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT wp.product_id, wp.product_name, ma.asset_id, ma.maturity_on AS asset_maturity_date, wp.actual_termination_on AS product_termination_date
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS borrower_count
FROM party p
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY guarantee_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    ptc.name_zh AS payment_type_name,
    ROUND(pe.amount, 2) AS amount,
    ou.unit_name AS org_unit_name
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
JOIN organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    op_ind.sector_name_zh AS borrower_industry_name,
    target_ind.sector_name_zh AS target_industry_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN industry_sector op_ind ON op_ind.sector_code = op.industry_code
JOIN industry_sector target_ind ON target_ind.sector_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code != op.industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT pe.payment_id, pe.business_date, pe.amount, pa.party_id AS payer_party_id, pb.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON ah_from.account_id = pe.from_account_id AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON ah_to.account_id = pe.to_account_id AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party pa ON pa.party_id = ah_from.party_id
JOIN party pb ON pb.party_id = ah_to.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = pa.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = pb.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND rtc.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
       ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a_from ON a_from.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = a_from.org_unit_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ou.institution_id
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON ptc.payment_type = pe.payment_type
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
  AND ptc.name_zh IN ('现金存入', '现金支取')
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT sm.staff_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = pe.to_account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector s ON s.sector_code = op.industry_code
JOIN service_operator so ON so.operator_id = pe.operator_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
WHERE s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY sm.staff_id
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT cdd.record_id, i.institution_name, cdd.event_date, cdd.deadline_date,
       CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(cdd.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_overdue
FROM customer_due_diligence_event_v3 cdd
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cdd.institution_id
WHERE cdd.completion_date IS NULL
  AND cdd.event_date <= '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY days_overdue DESC, cdd.record_id
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.status AS collateral_status,
    sa.status AS security_status
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'RELEASED' 
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    sa.security_id;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ca.agreement_id, sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
        ) as rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    rn AS balance_rank
FROM loan_balances
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        op.industry_code,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        industry_code,
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY industry_code ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_balances
)
SELECT 
    s.sector_name_zh,
    rl.loan_id,
    ROUND(rl.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    rl.rn AS industry_rank
FROM ranked_loans rl
JOIN industry_sector s ON s.sector_code = rl.industry_code
WHERE rl.rn <= 3
ORDER BY s.sector_name_zh, rl.rn;

SELECT business_date,
       tx_count,
       tx_count - LAG(tx_count, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM (
    SELECT business_date, COUNT(*) AS tx_count
    FROM payment_event
    GROUP BY business_date
) daily_stats
ORDER BY business_date;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(inst_avg.avg_balance, 2) AS avg_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - inst_avg.avg_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ca_sub.institution_id,
        AVG(lbs_sub.principal_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld_sub
    JOIN credit_agreement ca_sub ON ld_sub.agreement_id = ca_sub.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs_sub ON ld_sub.loan![](loan_id) = lbs_sub.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca_sub.institution_id
) inst_avg ON ca.institution_id = inst_avg.institution_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > inst_avg.avg_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT sa.security_id,
       sa.secured_amount,
       COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE cl.collateral_link_id IS NULL
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN '0'
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30'
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 3!0 AND 90 THEN '31-90'
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN '91-180'
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN '181-360'
        ELSE '360+'
    END AS overdue_range,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
GROUP BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 31
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 91
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 181
        ELSE 361
    END
ORDER BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 31
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 91
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 181
        ELSE 361
    END;

SELECT collateral_id, valued_on, COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM collateral_valuation
GROUP BY collateral_id, valued_on
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY collateral_id;

WITH corporate_loan_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.party_id,
        p.display_name,
        COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal,
        AVG(lbs.principal_balance) AS avg_single_amount
    FROM party p
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
      AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
)
SELECT 
    display_name,
    loan_count,
    ROUND(total_principal, 2) AS total_principal,
    ROUND(avg_single_amount, 2) AS avg_single_amount
FROM corporate_loan_stats
ORDER BY avg_single_amount DESC, display_name
LIMIT 5;

SELECT ou.unit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN service_operator so ON so.operator_id = pe.operator_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = sm.home_org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pp.annual_income), 2) AS avg_annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 6) AS high_income_ratio
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY p.customer_segment;

WITH base_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(ou_from.institution_id, ou_to.institution_id) AS institution_id,
        pe.amount,
        ah_from.party_id AS from_holder_id,
        ah_to.party_id AS to_holder_id
    FROM payment_event pe
    JOIN account a_from ON a_from.account_id = pe.from_account_id
    JOIN account a_to ON a_to.account_id = pe.to_account_id
    JOIN account_holder ah_from ON ah_from.account_id = a_from.account_id 
        AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
        AND (ah_from.effective_to IS NULL OR ah_from.effective_to > pe.business_date)
    JOIN account_holder ah_to ON ah_to.account_id = a_to.account_id 
        AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
        AND (ah_to.effective_to IS NULL OR ah_to.effective_to > pe.business_date)
    LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou_from ON ou_from.org_unit_id = a_from.org_unit_id
    LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou_to ON ou_to.org_unit_id = a_to.org_unit_id
    WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
),
related_check AS (
    SELECT 
        bt.institution_id,
        bt.amount,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM party_relation pr
                WHERE pr.source_party_id = bt.from_holder_id
                  AND pr.target_party_id = bt.to_holder_id
                  AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
                  AND (pr.effective_to IS NULL OR pr.effective_to > '2026-06-30')
            ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END AS is_related
    FROM base_transactions bt
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN rc.is_related = 1 THEN rc.amount ELSE 0 END) AS related_amount,
        SUM(rc.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM related_check rc
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = rc.institution_id
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    ROUND(related_amount, 2) AS related_amount,
    ROUND(total_amount, 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(related_amount * 1.0 / total_amount, 6) AS ratio
FROM aggregated
WHERE total_amount > 0
ORDER BY ratio DESC, institution_name;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pc.card_type = 'CREDIT' THEN pc.card_id END) AS credit_card_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS' AND td.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.account_id END) AS term_deposit_count
FROM party p
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id OR a.account_id IN (
    SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
)
LEFT JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND td.account_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.party_id, p!p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pc.card_type = 'CREDIT' THEN pc.card_id END) > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN td.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.account_id END) > 0
ORDER BY term_deposit_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY('2026-06-30') - JULIANDAY(ld.disbursed_on)), 2) AS avg_loan_age_days
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    avg_loan_age_days DESC;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM loan_balances
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    quartile_group
FROM ranked_loans
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH industry_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        i.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS balance_sum
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    JOIN industry_sector i ON i.sector_code = op.industry_code
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY i.sector_name_zh
),
total_balance AS (
    SELECT SUM(balance_sum) AS grand_total
    FROM industry_balances
),
ranked_industries AS (
    SELECT 
        ib.industry_name,
        ib.balance_sum,
        SUM(ib.balance_sum) OVER (ORDER BY ib.balance_sum DESC) AS cumulative_balance
    FROM industry_balances ib
)
SELECT 
    ri.industry_name,
    ROUND(ri.balance_sum, 2) AS balance_sum,
    ROUND(ri.cumulative_balance * 1.0 / tb.grand_total, 6) AS cumulative_ratio
FROM ranked_industries ri
CROSS JOIN total_balance tb
WHERE (ri.cumulative_balance * 1.0 / tb.grand_total) <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE ld.status != 'SETTLED' AND ld.status != 'WRITTEN_OFF'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount, ca.collateral_id, cv.valuation_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.valuation_amount > sa.secured_amount * 2.0
  AND cv.valued_on = (
      SELECT MAX(cv2.valued_on)
      FROM collateral_valuation cv2
      WHERE cv2.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
  )
ORDER BY (cv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC, sa.security_id, ca.collateral_id;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS institution_count
FROM party p
JOIN account a ON a.account_id IN (
    SELECT ah.account_id
    FROM account_holder ah
    WHERE ah.party_id = p.party_id
)
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 2
ORDER BY institution_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT from_account_id, business_date, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event
GROUP BY from_account_id, business_date
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, from_account_id, business_date
LIMIT 20;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_balance
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN exposure_group eg ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
    p.display_name AS party_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.security_id) AS contract_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gc.security_id) > 1 AND SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
  AND lbs.overdue_since IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(lbs.overdue_since) >= 90
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT ld.loan_id, p.display_name AS borrower_name, pi.instruction_amount, payee.display_name AS payee_name
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_instruction pi ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN party payee ON payee.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, ld.loan_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND p.status = 'FROZEN'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    lpc.product_name_zh,
    isec.sector_name_zh,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON lpc.product_code = ld.drawdown_type
JOIN industry_sector isec ON isec.sector_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND lpc.product_family = 'WORKING_CAPITAL'
  AND isec.risk_category = 'EXIT'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id
LIMIT 200;

WITH inst_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ROUND(AVG(lbs.principal_balance), 6) AS avg_bal
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(ia.avg_bal, 2) AS inst_avg_bal,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - ia.avg_bal, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN inst_avg ia ON ia.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 2 * ia.avg_bal
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

WITH all_agreements AS (
    SELECT ca.institution_id,
           SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
non_related_agreements AS (
    SELECT ca.institution_id,
           SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS non_related_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT pr.source_party_id
        FROM party_relation pr
        WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
          AND (pr.effective_to IS NULL OR pr.effective_to >= '2026-06-30')
          AND pr.effective_from <= '2026-06-30'
    )
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0), 2) AS non_related_amount,
       ROUND(aa.total_amount, 2) AS total_amount,
       ROUND(COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(aa.total_amount, 0), 6) AS ratio
FROM all_agreements aa
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = aa.institution_id
LEFT JOIN non_related_agreements nra ON nra.institution_id = aa.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id, ca.institution_id
),
capital_data AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND currency_code = 'CNY'
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    ROUND(lb.total_loan_balance, 2) AS total_loan_balance,
    ROUND(cd.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(lb.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / cd.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM loan_balances lb
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = lb.institution_id
JOIN capital_data cd ON cd.institution_id = lb.institution_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = lb.borrower_party_id
WHERE (lb.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / cd.net_capital) > 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH industry_avg_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.target_industry_code,
        AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_industry_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL 
      AND ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.target_industry_code
)
SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS execution_rate,
    ROUND(iar.avg_industry_rate, 4) AS industry_avg_rate,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - iar.avg_industry_rate) * 100.0 / iar.avg_industry_rate, 2) AS markup_percent
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_avg_rates iar ON ca.target_industry_code = iar.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate > iar.avg_industry_rate * 1.10
ORDER BY markup_percent DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS excess_customer_count
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > (cs.net_capital * 0.10)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY excess_customer_count DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH group_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_balance
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
),
capital_net AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot)
)
SELECT 
    ge.exposure_group_id AS group_id,
    ge.group_name,
    ROUND(ge.total_balance, 2) AS total_balance,
    ROUND(cn.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(ge.total_balance * 1.0 / cn.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM group_exposure ge
JOIN capital_net cn ON cn.institution_id = ge.institution_id
WHERE (ge.total_balance * 1.0 / cn.net_capital) > 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, ca.maturity_on, ld.loan_id, ld.status, ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'MATURED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_between
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.business_date >= ld.disbursed_on
  AND CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) <= 7
ORDER BY days_between ASC, pe.amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ld.agreement_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ld.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        lb.institution_id,
        lb.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lb.total_principal_balance) AS customer_total_balance
    FROM loan_balances lb
    GROUP BY lb.institution_id, lb.borrower_party_id
),
capital_net AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.institution_id,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-3!0'
),
ratios AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.institution_id,
        ct.borrower_party_id,
        ct.customer_total_balance,
        cn.net_capital,
        ROUND(ct.customer_total_balance * 1.0 / cn.net_capital, 6) AS ratio
    FROM customer_totals ct
    JOIN capital_net cn ON cn.institution_id = ct.institution_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        r.institution_id,
        r.borrower_party_id,
        r.ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.institution_id ORDER BY r.ratio DESC) AS rn
    FROM ratios r
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    ROUND(r.ratio, 6) AS ratio
FROM ranked r
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = r.borrower_party_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT loan_id, principal_balance, ntile(4) OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile
FROM (
    SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount - COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0) AS principal_balance, ca.institution_id
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
) sub
ORDER BY quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT ld.loan_id, i.institution_name, ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
       ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / inst_total.total_principal * 100, 2) AS ratio_percent
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca_inner.institution_id, SUM(lbs_inner.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld_inner
    JOIN credit_agreement ca_inner ON ca_inner.agreement_id = ld_inner.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs_inner ON lbs_inner.loan_id = ld_inner.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca_inner.institution_id
) inst_total ON inst_total.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC, ratio_percent DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
    ld.status,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal,
    COUNT(ds.delinquency_id) AS overdue_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING COUNT(ds.delinquency_id) >= 2
ORDER BY overdue_count DESC, total_overdue_principal DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
GROUP BY ld.disbursement_account_id, ld.disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, ld.disbursement_account_id, ld.disbursed_on
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT ah.party_id
FROM account_holder ah
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = a.account_id
INTERSECT
SELECT ca.borrower_party_id
FROM credit_agreement ca
ORDER BY party_id;

SELECT p.party_id
FROM party p
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ah.party_id IS NULL
ORDER BY p.party_id;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM payment_event pe
    WHERE pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
      AND pe.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT security_id, guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment
WHERE status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY guaranteed_amount DESC, security_id;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) < 0 THEN '已到期'
        WHEN julianday('2026-06-3!0') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN '临期'
        ELSE '常态'
    END AS term_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
WHERE ld.status != 'WRITTEN_OFF'
GROUP BY term_bucket
ORDER BY 
    CASE term_bucket
        WHEN '常态' THEN 1
        WHEN '临期' THEN 2
        WHEN '已到期' THEN 3
    END;

SELECT ca.collateral_id, COUNT(*) AS link_count
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY link_count DESC, ca.collateral_id;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_type,
    ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS avg_valuation,
    COUNT(*) AS eval_count
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY avg_valuation DESC, ca.collateral_type;

WITH account_loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ld.repayment_account_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN account_loan_counts alc ON alc.repayment_account_id = ld.repayment_account_id
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    rl.repayment_account_id,
    rl.loan_id,
    rl.disbursed_on,
    ROUND(rl.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
    alc.loan_count
FROM ranked_loans rl
JOIN account_loan_counts alc ON alc.repayment_account_id = rl.repayment_account_id
WHERE rl.rn <= 2
ORDER BY rl.repayment_account_id ASC, rl.disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_disbursed,
       ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount, 2) AS excess_amount,
       COUNT(*) AS drawdown_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(a.account_id) AS 账户数量,
       ROUND(SUM(abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance), 2) AS 差额合计
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot abs ON abs.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE abs.ledger_balance > abs.available_balance
  AND (abs.ledger_balance![] - abs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 差额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    td.opening_principal,
    td.maturity_on,
    td.annual_interest_rate
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on <= '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT card_id, card_type, issued_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'DEBIT'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
ORDER BY issued_on, card_id;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS entrusted_total,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS self_total,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6) AS entrusted_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6) < 0.52
ORDER BY entrusted_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

WITH contract_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.agreement_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
)
SELECT 
    ld.agreement_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    ct.total_disbursed,
    ROUND((ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0) / ct.total_disbursed, 2) AS single_drawdown_ratio_pct
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN contract_totals ct ON ld.agreement_id = ct.agreement_id
WHERE (ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0) / ct.total_disbursed > 90
ORDER BY ld.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS 实际募集合计,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 计划募集合计,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 6) AS 完成率
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution i ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) > 1.2
ORDER BY 完成率 DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) AS overdue_loan_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS total_loan_count
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status != 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p_borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p_payee.display_name AS actual_payee_name,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p_borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = p_borrower.party_id
JOIN party p_payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p_payee.party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id != ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.agreement_id,
    ca.signed_on,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id;

WITH unpaid_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.loan_id,
        COUNT(*) AS unpaid_installment_count,
        SUM(rs.principal_due) AS total_principal_due
    FROM repayment_schedule rs
    GROUP BY rs.loan_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
)
SELECT 
    ul.loan_id,
    ul.unpaid_installment_count,
    ROUND(ul.total_principal_due, 2) AS total_principal_due
FROM unpaid_loans ul
ORDER BY ul.total_principal_due DESC, ul.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance, ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.loan_account_id,
    a.opened_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on, ld.loan_id;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.disbursement_account_id, a.account_kind, ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, ca.security_type AS 担保方式，ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 合同金额，p.display_name AS 借款人名称
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE ca.security_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH product_avg_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family,
        ROUND(AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate), 4) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.product_family
),
related_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pr.source_party_id
    FROM party_relation pr
    WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
)
SELECT 
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS borrower_id,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS contract_rate,
    par.avg_rate AS peer_avg_rate,
    ROUND(par.avg_rate - ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS rate_gap
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN related_borrowers rb ON rb.source_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN product_avg_rates par ON par.institution_id = ca.institution_id 
    AND par.product_family = ca.product_family
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate < par.avg_rate
ORDER BY rate_gap DESC, p.display_name;

SELECT pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id, rtc.relation_name_zh
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN credit_agreement ca_src ON ca_src.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca_tgt ON ca_tgt.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
  AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
ORDER BY rtc.relation_name_zh, pr.relation_id;

SELECT 
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称，
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 成员数，
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 余额合计，
    cs.net_capital AS 资本净额，
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS 占比
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id 
    FROM credit_agreement ca 
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id 
      AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30' AND cs.currency_code = 'CNY'
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 2 
   AND (SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) > 0.1
ORDER BY 占比 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT p_from.display_name AS 付款方姓名,
       p_to.display_name AS 收款方姓名,
       COUNT(*) AS 转账笔数,
       ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 转账金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON ah_from.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON ah_to.account_id = pe.to_account_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = ah_from.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ah_to.party_id
JOIN party p_from ON p_from.party_id = ah_from.party_id
JOIN party p_to ON p_to.party_id = ah_to.party_id
WHERE pe.payment_type = 'TRANSFER'
  AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY p_from.display_name, p_to.display_name
ORDER BY 转账金额合计 DESC, 付款方姓名, 收款方姓名;

SELECT wp.product_id, wp.product_name, ma.asset_name
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND phs.investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
ORDER BY wp.product_id;

SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot
WHERE investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, product_id
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS max_overdue_days
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE 
    lbs.principal_balance > 90000000
    AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY 
    ld.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance
HAVING 
    MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY 
    max_overdue_days DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号，eg.group_name AS 集团名称，
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS 涉及机构数，
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 取得授信的成员数
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
   AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 涉及机构数 DESC, eg.exposure_group_id;

SELECT eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号，eg.group_name AS 集团名称，
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 逾期成员数，
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id 
    FROM credit_agreement ca 
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, eg.exposure_group_id;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS enterprise_name,
    p.party_id,
    ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guarantee_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_loan_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount) - SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 2) AS guarantee_loan_diff
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount) > SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount)
ORDER BY guarantee_loan_diff DESC;

SELECT p.display_name AS employee_name, sm.staff_id AS employee_id, COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS agreement_count
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sm.staff_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY agreement_count DESC, employee_name;

SELECT p.display_name, p.party_id, ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计, pp.annual_income, ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN account a ON p.party_id = a.account_id -- Assuming account holder logic maps directly or via account_holder, simplified for direct join based on schema context if party_id matches account_id in specific views, but strictly following schema:
-- Correction: Need to join via account_holder or assume loan_drawdown links to party.
-- Re-evaluating schema paths:
-- loan_drawdown -> credit_agreement -> borrower_party_id (party)
-- loan_balance_snapshot -> loan_drawdown
-- So: party <- credit_agreement <- loan_drawdown <- loan_balance_snapshot

SELECT p.display_name, p.party_id, ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计, pp.annual_income, ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) > 2.0
ORDER BY 倍数 DESC, p.party_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS staff_name,
    so.operator_id,
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS self_loan_contract_count
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN service_operator so ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE so.operator_kind = 'CREDIT_OPERATOR'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.display_name, so.operator_id, so.authority_level
ORDER BY self_loan_contract_count DESC;

SELECT p.display_name AS 员工姓名，ld.loan_id AS 借据编号，
       ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS 放款金额，ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ah.party_id AND p.party_type = 'STAFF'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

WITH borrower_repayment AS (
    SELECT 
        p.party_id,
        p.display_name,
        SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) AS total_due_amount
    FROM repayment_schedule rs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    GROUP BY p.party_id, p!display_name
),
borrower_income AS (
    SELECT 
        pp.party_id,
        pp.annual_income
    FROM person_profile pp
)
SELECT 
    br.display_name AS 借款人姓名，
    br.party_id AS 借款人客户编号，
    ROUND(bi.annual_income, 2) AS 个人年收入，
    ROUND(br.total_due_amount, 2) AS 应还本息总额，
    ROUND(br.total_due_amount * 1.0 / bi.annual_income, 2) AS 占年收入倍数
FROM borrower_repayment br
JOIN borrower_income bi ON br.party_id = bi.party_id
WHERE bi.annual_income IS NOT NULL AND bi.annual_income > 0
ORDER BY 占年收入倍数 DESC, br.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT lpc.product_name_zh AS 产品类别名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rs.installment_id) AS 逾期期数,
       ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON lpc.product_code = ld.drawdown_type
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND rs.paid_on IS NULL
GROUP BY lpc.product_code, lpc.product_name_zh
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 END) AS expired_count,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-3!30' AND td.maturity_on <= date('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 END) AS due_90_days_count,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > date('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 END) AS due_over_90_days_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 END) >= 20
ORDER BY expired_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(*) AS joint_account_count
FROM account a
JOIN account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE a.account_kind IN ('SAVINGS', 'CURRENT', 'INTERNAL')
GROUP BY a.account_id, ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ah.party_id) > 1
ORDER BY joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号，ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称，
       COUNT(*) AS 逾期笔数，ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = ca.managing_org_unit_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > 0
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT rs.loan_id,
       COUNT(*) AS 逾期期数，
       ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND rs.principal_due > 0
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING SUM(rs.principal_due) > 120000000
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, rs.loan_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count,
       ROUND(SUM(rs.interest_due), 2) AS total_overdue_interest
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 240
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT loan_id, installment_no, principal_due, interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule
WHERE status = 'OVERDUE' AND principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY principal_due DESC, loan_id, installment_no;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_credit_limit,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_disbursed,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS disbursed_to_capital_ratio
FROM 
    credit_facility cf
JOIN 
    institution i ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
        SELECT ca.agreement_id 
        FROM credit_agreement ca 
        WHERE ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
    )
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id 
    AND cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM capital_snapshot 
        WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING 
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 
    disbursed_to_capital_ratio DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE 
    sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    cf.facility_id,
    cf.limit_amount,
    sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM 
    credit_facility cf
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc ON sc.entity = 'credit_agreement' AND sc.status_code = cf.status
WHERE 
    cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
ORDER BY 
    cf.limit_amount DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称，cf.facility_type AS 授信类型代码，ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 授信限额合计
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cf.facility_type
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY 授信限额合计 DESC, i.institution_name, cf.facility_type;

SELECT cf.facility_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM credit_facility cf
WHERE cf.limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY cf.facility_type
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

SELECT pm.payment_mode_name_zh, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS record_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pm ON pm.payment_mode = ld.payment_mode
GROUP BY pm.payment_mode, pm.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

WITH ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        minimum_holding_days,
        actual_raise_amount,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE'
),
filtered_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        quartile_group,
        COUNT(*) AS product_count
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
    GROUP BY quartile_group
    HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 31 AND 33
)
SELECT 
    quartile_group,
    product_count
FROM filtered_groups
ORDER BY quartile_group;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 循环授信限额合计,
       COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 发放笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.facility_id = ca.facility_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
ORDER BY 循环授信限额合计 DESC;

SELECT pm.payment_mode_name_zh, COUNT(*) AS pending_count
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pm ON pm.payment_mode = pi.payment_mode
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY pm.payment_mode, pm.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY pending_count DESC;

SELECT it.name_zh AS 融资工具中文名称, sc.name_zh AS 实体状态中文名称
FROM instrument_type_catalog it
CROSS JOIN status_catalog sc
WHERE sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY it.name_zh, sc.name_zh;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.staff_id) AS credit_manager_count
FROM staff_assignment sa
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = sa.org_unit_id
WHERE sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_MANAGER'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY credit_manager_count DESC, ou.unit_name;

select 
    ld.loan_id, 
    cg.grade_name_zh, 
    ds.principal_overdue_days, 
    ds.overdue_principal
from loan_drawdown ld
join delinquency_snapshot ds on ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
join risk_classification rc on rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id and rc.as_of_date = ds.as_of_date
join classification_grade cg on cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
where ds.principal_overdue_days > 30 
  and cg.grade_code = 'NORMAL'
order by ds.principal_overdue_days desc, ld.loan_id;

select i.institution_name, count(*) as 借据笔数
from provision_snapshot ps
join loan_drawdown ld on ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
join credit_agreement ca on ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
join institution i on i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
where ps.provision_stage = 'STAGE_2'
  and ps.recognized_amount * 1.0 / ps.required_amount < 0.5
group by i.institution_name
order by 借据笔数 desc, i.institution_name

select i.institution_name, round(sum(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) as 拨备缺口合计
from provision_snapshot ps
join loan_drawdown ld on ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
join credit_agreement ca on ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
join institution i on i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
where ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
group by i.institution_name
order by 拨备缺口合计 desc, i.institution_name

SELECT a.account_id, a.account_subtype, ROUND(bs.ledger_balance, 2) AS ledger_balance
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot bs ON bs.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
WHERE a.status = 'DORMANT'
  AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND ah.account_holder_id IS NULL
  AND bs.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(as_of_date)
      FROM account_balance_snapshot
      WHERE account_id = a.account_id
  )
ORDER BY bs.ledger_balance DESC, a.account_id;

SELECT p.customer_segment AS 客户分层，
       COUNT(*) AS 客户数量
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 客户数量 DESC, p.customer_segment;

SELECT ma.asset_category_primary,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN industry_sector i ON ma.industry_code = i.sector_code
WHERE i.risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
  AND ma.asset_scope = 'NON_STANDARDIZED'
GROUP BY ma.asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY cnt DESC, ma.asset_category_primary;

WITH customer_income AS (
    SELECT 
        p.party_id,
        pp.annual_income
    FROM party p
    JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
      AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
),
customer_credit_limit AS (
    SELECT 
        cf.obligor_party_id,
        SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_limit
    FROM credit_facility cf
    GROUP BY cf.obligor_party_id
)
SELECT 
    ci.party_id AS 客户编号，
    ci.annual_income AS 年收入，
    ROUND(ccl.total_limit, 2) AS 授信额度合计，
    ROUND(ccl.total_limit * 1.0 / ci.annual_income, 2) AS 偿债比
FROM customer_income ci
JOIN customer_credit_limit ccl ON ccl.obligor_party_id = ci.party_id
WHERE (ccl.total_limit * 1.0 / ci.annual_income) > 3
ORDER BY 偿债比 DESC, ci.party_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT pp.occupation_code, pp.employment_sector, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM person_profile pp
GROUP BY pp.occupation_code, pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, pp.occupation_code, pp.employment_sector;

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'DEBIT'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY card_count DESC, status;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号, ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称, COUNT(*) AS 交易笔数, ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pc.holder_party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = p.home_org_unit_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON ctc.card_type = pc.card_type
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON ptc.payment_type = pe.payment_type
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
  AND (ptc.name_zh = '现金支取' OR pe.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL')
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 金额合计 DESC, ou.unit_name ASC;

SELECT pe.payment_id,
       pc.card_id,
       pc.holder_party_id,
       pe.business_date,
       pe.amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id, pc.card_id
LIMIT 10;

SELECT pc.holder_party_id,
       COUNT(*) AS cash_txn_count,
       ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON ctc.card_type = pc.card_type
WHERE ctc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY cash_txn_count DESC, total_amount DESC, pc.holder_party_id;

SELECT holder_party_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY card_count DESC, holder_party_id ASC;

SELECT ct.name_zh AS card_type_name,
       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
       ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS avg_single_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.card_id = pe.from_account_id OR pc.card_id = pe.to_account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ct ON ct.card_type = pc.card_type
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND ct.name_zh IN ('贷记卡', '借记卡')
GROUP BY ct.card_type, ct.name_zh
ORDER BY avg_single_amount DESC, ct.name_zh ASC;

SELECT pe.channel,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt,
       ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS avg_amt
FROM payment_event pe
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.is_cash = 0
GROUP BY pe.channel
HAVING ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) > 11780000
ORDER BY avg_amt DESC, pe.channel;

SELECT a.account_id, t.maturity_on, a.status
FROM account a
JOIN term_deposit t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND t.maturity_on <= '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t.maturity_on DESC, a.account_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id AS 抵质押物编号，
    ca.asset_label AS 名称，
    ROUND(MAX(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS 最高评估价值
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cv.valuation_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 最高评估价值 DESC, ca.collateral_id;

select ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, count(*) as 引用次数, count(distinct cl.security_id) as 担保合同数
from collateral_asset ca
join collateral_link cl on cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
where ca.status = 'ACTIVE' and cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
group by ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
having count(*) >= 2
order by 引用次数 desc, ca.collateral_id

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.agreement_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.agreement_id
),
guarantor_exposures AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        so.agreement_id,
        gc.guaranteed_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
    JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND so.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    ge.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人客户编号，
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称，
    ge.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号，
    ROUND(ge.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS 保证承诺金额，
    ROUND(COALESCE(lt.total_disbursed, 0), 2) AS 合同实际放款总金额
FROM guarantor_exposures ge
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ge.guarantor_party_id
LEFT JOIN loan_totals lt ON lt.agreement_id = ge.agreement_id
WHERE ge.guaranteed_amount > COALESCE(lt.total_disbursed, 0)
ORDER BY 保证承诺金额 DESC, 保证人客户编号 ASC, 授信合同编号 ASC;

select 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    round(ca.contract_amount, 2) as 授信合同金额,
    round(coalesce(sum(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) as 担保覆盖合计,
    round(ca.contract_amount - coalesce(sum(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) as 保障缺口
from credit_agreement ca
left join secured_obligation so on so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
left join security_agreement sa on sa.security_id = so.security_id
where ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  and (sa.status = 'ACTIVE' or sa.status is null)
group by ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
having ca.contract_amount > coalesce(sum(so.covered_amount), 0)
order by 保障缺口 desc, ca.agreement_id
limit 1!00

select i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh, count(*) as 拨备不足借据笔数
from risk_classification rc
join loan_drawdown ld on ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
join credit_agreement ca on ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
join institution i on i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
join classification_grade cg on cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
join provision_snapshot ps on ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id and ps.as_of_date = rc.as_of_date
where rc.grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
  and ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
group by i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
order by 拨备不足借据笔数 desc, i.institution_name

select 
    ca.borrower_party_id, 
    ld.loan_id, 
    round(lbs.principal_balance, 2) as loan_balance, 
    ca.contract_amount as credit_limit, 
    round(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) as balance_multiple
from loan_drawdown ld
join credit_agreement ca on ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
join loan_balance_snapshot lbs on ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
where lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  and lbs.principal_balance >= ca.contract_amount * 4.0
order by balance_multiple desc, ld.loan_id;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS 多计提笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount), 2) AS 多计提金额合计
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = rc.as_of_date
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 多计提金额合计 DESC, i.institution_name ASC, cg.grade_name_zh ASC;

WITH internal_max AS (
    SELECT ca.collateral_id, MAX(cv.valuation_amount) AS max_val
    FROM collateral_asset ca
    JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
    WHERE cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
    GROUP BY ca.collateral_id
),
external_max AS (
    SELECT ca.collateral_id, MAX(cv.valuation_amount) AS max_val
    FROM collateral_asset ca
