    JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
    WHERE cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL'
    GROUP BY ca.collateral_id
)
SELECT ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label,
       ROUND(im.max_val, 2) AS internal_max_value,
       ROUND(em.max_val, 2) AS external_max_value,
       ROUND(im.max_val - em.max_val, 2) AS undervaluation_diff
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN internal_max im ON im.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN external_max em ON em.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE em.max_val < im.max_val
ORDER BY undervaluation_diff DESC, ca.collateral_id;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    latest_val.valuation_amount AS latest_valuation,
    SUM(cl.pledged_amount) AS total_pledged_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(cl.pledged_amount) - latest_val.valuation_amount, 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        cv.collateral_id,
        cv.valuation_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cv.collateral_id ORDER BY cv.valued_on DESC) as rn
    FROM collateral_valuation cv
) latest_val ON latest_val.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id AND latest_val.rn = 1
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, latest_val.valuation_amount
HAVING SUM(cl.pledged_amount) > latest_val.valuation_amount
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号，
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称，
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 自身借款金额合计，
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 对外保证金额合计
FROM party p
-- 子查询：找出自身有授信借款的保证人及其借款合同金额
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id, 
        ca.contract_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
) ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
-- 子查询：找出对外提供有效担保的保证人及其担保承诺金额
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id, 
        gc.guaranteed_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
) gc ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > SUM(ca.contract_amount)
ORDER BY 对外保证金额合计 DESC, 保证人编号;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_commitment
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY total_commitment DESC;

SELECT p.customer_segment,
       COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND pp.is_public_official = 1
  AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       egtc.name_zh,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_type_catalog egtc ON egtc.group_type = eg.group_type
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY eg.institution_id, i.institution_name, eg.group_type, egtc.name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT 
    egm.party_id AS 成员客户编号，
    p.display_name AS 客户名称，
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, egm.party_id;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 主体编号，
    p.display_name AS 主体名称，
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数，
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON (pr.source_party_id = p.party_id OR pr.target_party_id = p.party_id)
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
  AND rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联关系条数 DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT p.party_id,
       p.display_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id OR pr.target_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh = '影子股东'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY group_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT 
    pr.relation_id AS 关系编号，
    pr.source_party_id AS 关系一方主体编号，
    pr.target_party_id AS 关系另一方主体编号，
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_src.agreement_id) AS 一主体现有借款合同数，
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_tgt.agreement_id) AS 另一主体现有借款合同数
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN credit_agreement ca_src 
    ON ca_src.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id 
    AND ca_src.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN credit_agreement ca_tgt 
    ON ca_tgt.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id 
    AND ca_tgt.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc 
    ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type 
    AND rtc.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT ca_src.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca_tgt.agreement_id)) DESC, pr.relation_id;

select ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, ca.collateral_type
from collateral_asset ca
where ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  and not exists (
    select 1
    from collateral_link cl
    where cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
      and cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
order by ca.collateral_id

WITH guarantor_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    JOIN security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE' 
      AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
borrower_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        p.party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM party p
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND lbs.as_of_date = (
          SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
          FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
          WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
      )
    GROUP BY p.party_id
)
SELECT 
    ge.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号，
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称，
    ROUND(ge.total_guarantee, 2) AS 有效保证责任合计，
    ROUND(COALESCE(be.total_loan_balance, 0.0), 2) AS 自身贷款金额，
    ROUND(ge.total_guarantee - COALESCE(be.total!total_loan_balance, 0.0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM guarantor_exposure ge
JOIN party p ON ge.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN borrower_exposure be ON ge.guarantor_party_id = be.party_id
WHERE ge.total_guarantee > COALESCE(be.total_loan_balance, 0.0)
ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC, ge.guarantor_party_id;

SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(gc.guar!guaranteed_amount, 2) AS guaranteed_amount,
    gc.status AS guarantee_status
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON gc.guarantor_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
  AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name, gc.guaranteed_amount, gc.status
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name AS 产品名称，
    ma.asset_name AS 底层资产名称，
    ma.obligor_party_id AS 最终债务人编号，
    ROUND(SUM(ld.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ma.obligor_party_id = (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id 
    FROM credit_agreement ca 
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld_inner ON ca.agreement_id = ld_inner.agreement_id 
    WHERE ld_inner.loan_id = ld.loan_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE wp.issuer_institution_id = (
    SELECT institution_id FROM institution WHERE institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
)
AND ma.obligor_party_id IN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld_sub ON ca.agreement_id = ld_sub.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs_sub ON ld_sub.loan_id = lbs_sub.loan_id
    WHERE ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
      AND lbs_sub.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND lbs_sub.overdue_principal > 0
)
AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY wp.product_name ASC, 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT sa.security_type,
       COUNT(sa.security_id) AS contract_count,
       ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS total_covered_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
WHERE sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY SUM(so.covered_amount) DESC, sa.security_type;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cla.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cla ON cla.security_id = sa.security_id AND cla.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cla.collateral_id) > 0 
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) > 0
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
       ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value), 2) AS total_inversion_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS inversion_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY total_inversion_amount DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, phs.lookthrough_depth, phs.carrying_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(dls.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot dls ON dls.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
  AND ma.obligor_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, phs.lookthrough_depth, phs.carrying_amount, phs.holding_id
HAVING SUM(dls.overdue_principal) > 0
ORDER BY phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS 第一顺位有效记录数，
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 超过百分之六十的记录数
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE' 
  AND cl.lien_priority = 1
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 超过百分之六十的记录数 DESC, ca.collateral_id;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name, 
    ROUND(f.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets, 
    ROUND(f.total_liabilities, 2) AS total_liabilities, 
    ROUND(f.net_assets, 2) AS net_assets, 
    ROUND(f.annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(SUM(f.total_liabilities) * 1.0 / SUM(f.total_assets), 4) AS debt_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY debt_ratio DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS core_tier1_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY core_tier1_ratio DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name, ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS ratio_val
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30' AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY ratio_val DESC;

WITH inst_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        fs.annual_revenue
    FROM institution i
    JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    WHERE fs.source_kind = 'AUDITED'
),
total_revenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(annual_revenue) AS total_amt FROM inst_revenue
)
SELECT 
    ir.institution_name,
    ROUND(ir.annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue,
    ROUND(ir.annual_revenue * 1.0 / tr.total_amt, 6) AS revenue_ratio
FROM inst_revenue ir
CROSS JOIN total_revenue tr
WHERE ir.annual_revenue * 1.0 / tr.total_amt > 0.15
ORDER BY revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS inconsistent_count
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY inconsistent_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT ma.valuation_method, ROUND(SUM(ph.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN product_holding_snapshot ph ON ph.asset_id = ma.asset_id
GROUP BY ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS account_count, ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 0.03
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT so.authority_level,
       COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = 'FIXED_TERM'
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30'
  AND td.maturity_on <= date('2026-06-30', '+30 days')
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH under_provision AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS under_provision_total,
        fs.net_assets
    FROM provision_snapshot ps
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
        AND fs.as_of_date = (
            SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
            FROM financial_snapshot 
            WHERE party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
        )
    WHERE ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets
    HAVING SUM(ps.required_amount![] - ps.recognized_amount) > 0
)
SELECT 
    institution_id,
    institution_name,
    under_provision_total,
    net_assets,
    ROUND(under_provision_total * 1.0 / net_assets * 100, 2) AS under_provision_ratio_pct
FROM under_provision
ORDER BY under_provision_ratio_pct DESC, institution_id ASC;

SELECT cg.grade_name_zh AS 风险分类名称，
       COUNT(DISTINCT rc.loan_id) AS 借据数量
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rc.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 借据数量 DESC, 风险分类名称 ASC;

WITH npl_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS npl_loan_count,
        SUM(ds.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
      AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY i.institution_id
),
revenue_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        fs.annual_revenue
    FROM financial_snapshot fs
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = fs.party_id
    WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND fs.party_id LIKE 'PTY-%'
)
SELECT 
    n.institution_id,
    n.npl_loan_count,
    ROUND(n.total_overdue_principal, 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM npl_stats n
JOIN revenue_stats r ON n.institution_id = r.institution_id
WHERE r.annual_revenue > 0 
  AND (n.total_overdue_principal * 1.0 / r.annual_revenue) > 0.5
ORDER BY n.total_overdue_principal DESC;

WITH loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
rwa AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        risk_weighted_assets
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称，
    ROUND(lb.total_principal, 2) AS 本金余额合计，
    ROUND(r.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS 风险加权资产，
    ROUND(lb.total_principal * 1.0 / r.risk_weighted_assets * 100, 2) AS 贷款占风险加权资产百分比
FROM loan_balance lb
JOIN rwa r ON r.institution_id = lb.institution_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = lb.institution_id
ORDER BY 贷款占风险加权资产百分比 DESC, 机构名称 ASC;

SELECT pi.payment_mode,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY cnt DESC, pi.payment_mode;

WITH abnormal_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS abnormal_count,
        SUM(r.amount_value) AS abnormal_amount
    FROM prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 r
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
    WHERE r.exception_flag = 1
    GROUP BY i.institution_id
),
capital_data AS (
    SELECT 
        c.institution_id,
        SUM(c.net_capital) AS net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot c
    WHERE c.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot)
    GROUP BY c.institution_id
),
asset_data AS (
    SELECT 
        p.party_id,
        SUM(f.total_assets) AS total_assets
    FROM financial_snapshot f
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = f.party_id
    WHERE f.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM financial_snapshot)
    GROUP BY p.party_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    am.abnormal_count,
    ROUND(am.abnormal_amount, 2) AS abnormal_amount,
    ROUND(cd.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(ad.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
    ROUND((am.abnormal_amount * 1.0 / cd.net_capital) * 100, 4) AS ratio_to_net_capital
FROM abnormal_metrics am
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = am.institution_id
JOIN capital_data cd ON cd.institution_id = am.institution_id
JOIN asset_data ad ON ad.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE am.abnormal_count >= 8
ORDER BY ratio_to_net_capital DESC;

WITH overdue_submissions AS (
    SELECT r.institution_id,
           COUNT(*) AS overdue_cnt,
           ROUND(AVG(r.amount_value), 2) AS avg_amount
    FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
    WHERE (r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
    GROUP BY r.institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 25
),
provision_gap AS (
    SELECT a.institution_id,
           COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS gap_loan_cnt,
           ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount THEN (ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS gap_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement a ON a.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       o.overdue_cnt,
       o.avg_amount,
       COALESCE(p.gap_loan_cnt, 0) AS gap_loan_cnt,
       COALESCE(p.gap_amount, 0.00) AS gap_amount
FROM overdue_submissions o
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = o.institution_id
LEFT JOIN provision_gap p ON p.institution_id = o.institution_id
ORDER BY gap_amount DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH facility_stats AS (
    SELECT i.institution_id,
           COUNT(*) AS facility_cnt
    FROM credit_facility cf
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
),
governance_stats AS (
    SELECT r.institution_id,
           ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.exception_flag = 1 THEN r.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS except_amount,
           ROUND(AVG(r.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio,
           COUNT(*) AS exc_cnt
    FROM governance_control_record_v3 r
    WHERE r.exception_flag = 1
    GROUP BY r.institution_id
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       fs.facility_cnt,
       gs.except_amount,
       gs.avg_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN facility_stats fs ON fs.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN governance_stats gs ON gs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE gs.exc_cnt >= 5
ORDER BY gs.except_amount DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH target_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.source_party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS distinct_targets,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS distinct_types,
        SUM(CASE WHEN rt.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_related_count
    FROM party_relation pr
    JOIN relation_type_catalog rt ON rt.relation_type = pr.relation_type
    GROUP BY pr.source_party_id
)
SELECT 
    p.display_name,
    ts.distinct_targets,
    ts.distinct_types,
    ts.non_related_count
FROM related_transaction_record_v3 r
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = r.subject_id
JOIN target_stats ts ON ts.source_party_id = r.subject_id
WHERE r.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, ts.distinct_targets, ts.distinct_types, ts.non_related_count
ORDER BY ts.distinct_targets DESC, ts.distinct_types DESC, p.display_name ASC;

WITH card_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS valid_customer_count
    FROM payment_card pc
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
    WHERE pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
),
risk_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        r.institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS valid_record_count,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.exception_flag = 1 THEN r.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount
    FROM operational_risk_event_v3 r
    WHERE r.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY r.institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 43
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cs.valid_card_count,
    cs.valid_customer_count,
    rs.exception_amount,
    rs.valid_record_count
FROM risk_stats rs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = rs.institution_id
JOIN card_stats cs ON cs.institution_id = rs.institution_id
ORDER BY rs.exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

WITH product_stats AS (
    SELECT w.issuer_institution_id AS institution_id,
           COUNT(*) AS on_sale_count,
           ROUND(SUM(w.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS total_raised
    FROM wealth_product w
    WHERE w.status = 'ON_SALE'
    GROUP BY w.issuer_institution_id
),
behavior_stats AS (
    SELECT r.institution_id,
           COUNT(*) AS record_count,
           ROUND(AVG(r.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
    FROM product_conduct_event_v3 r
    WHERE r.exception_flag = 1
    GROUP BY r.institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       ps.on_sale_count,
       ps.total_raised,
       bs.record_count,
       bs.avg_ratio
FROM behavior_stats bs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = bs.institution_id
JOIN product_stats ps ON ps.institution_id = bs.institution_id
ORDER BY ps.total_raised DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH asset_stats AS (
    SELECT m.originator_institution_id AS institution_id,
           COUNT(*) AS asset_count,
           ROUND(SUM(m.issued_amount), 2) AS issued_total
    FROM managed_asset m
    GROUP BY m.originator_institution_id
),
custody_stats AS (
    SELECT r.institution_id,
           COUNT(*) AS valid_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN r.exception_flag = 1 THEN r.amount_value ELSE 0 END) AS exception_amount,
           SUM(CASE WHEN r.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exception_count
    FROM custody_operation_event_v3 r
    WHERE r.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY r.institution_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN r.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       a.asset_count,
       a.issued_total,
       c.valid_count,
       ROUND(c.exception_amount, 2) AS exception_amount_total
FROM asset_stats a
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN custody_stats c ON c.institution_id = a.institution_id
ORDER BY a.issued_total DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
